objective: Compare independently verified repairs using the same locally served model through the three available headless CLIs.
ordering: Rotate the starting agent on each repetition, run one agent at a time in a fresh worktree.
primary: Count of verifier-accepted in-scope repairs within the agent deadline.
secondary: Wall time including Git worktree creation, negative control, agent startup and execution, final checker, and cleanup. Include failed and timed-out runs in total time.
interpretation: Descriptive paired pilot. Repetitions are not independent workloads. Identical model weights do not make prompts, tool selection, transport, or cache behavior identical.
